submission.rationale: The owner contract states workspace.close may compare-and-close against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and a mismatched planning digest fails not_committed. The consequenceBoundaryEvidence indicates the owner changed after planning (source identity advanced), meaning the planning-time digest is stale. Trying to close with the stale digest would fail not_committed. The contract's recovery path is to re-observe to get the new exact current digest and then close against it. I should not act on stale evidence, nor hold or replay blindly, but re-observation is the appropriate step before deciding whether to close.
